gateTitle: This screen is only available to the contractor
evidenceEmpty: Nothing attached yet — you can still submit
draftHint: Until you submit, files stay on your device. Delete any of them — nothing has gone to the other side yet.
draftSendFailed: Some files couldn’t be sent. The milestone wasn’t submitted — try again.
draftCustomerHint: For now these files are only on this device. Nothing has reached the other side yet — you can delete any of them.
draftDescriptionHint: One for all attached files. It cannot be changed after sending.
draftSendHint: Once sent, the files become immutable — you will not be able to delete them.
draftSendFailedAttach: Some files couldn’t be sent. Try again.
previewUnavailable: No preview — the file is stored and its hash is fixed
uploaderBindHint: Attach it to an item — makes it clearer during acceptance
cameraStubText: Precise capture with markers — in the app (soon). For now, upload from your device.
storageInfoText: The original stays with you (on your device). The platform stores a hash, timestamp, and thumbnail. Connect a backup to Google Drive so you don’t lose the original.
storageOkTitle: A copy is saved in Drive
storageOkText: A copy is saved in your Google Drive. Originals are with you and in Drive. The platform keeps a hash and a thumbnail.
backupPromptText: A backup in Google Drive means your original stays safe even if something happens to your device.
submitHint: You can submit without evidence too. With it, your position is stronger if a dispute comes up
submitSuspendedHint: This becomes active once you resume work
submitWillGo: The milestone goes to {{name}} for acceptance
submitWillLocked: Once submitted, milestone evidence can’t be changed
timerHint: If the customer doesn’t respond by {{date}}, the milestone is accepted automatically. You don’t need to do anything.
acceptedText: The evidence is preserved unchanged. Next: payment or the next milestone.
suspendedText: Work is suspended — the milestone will resume once the condition is met.
notPerformerTitle: This screen is for the milestone’s contractor
realAutoStartNote: The milestone starts automatically once every condition is met
realGateReasonPaymentNotConfirmed: Waiting for both sides to confirm the payment
realGateReasonAwaitingPayment: Waiting on payment — the payments module isn't connected yet
realStartBlockedNotSigned: The contract isn't signed yet — the stage can't start.
realStartBlockedMaterials: Not all of the customer's materials have been received.
realStartBlockedFinancial: The financial condition for the start isn't met yet.
realDisputedText: A dispute is open on this milestone — the evidence below is preserved unchanged.
realAcceptanceNotPlacedYet: Waiting for the notice to be placed in the customer's personal area — the acceptance window starts from there.
realEvidenceImmutableHint: Uploaded evidence can't be deleted or replaced — that's what makes it evidence.
realUploadTooLarge: File is over 25 MB — choose a smaller one
realNotPartyTitle: You're not a party to this contract
realNoChecklistHint: This milestone has no checklist items — there's nothing specific to reject, only accept
realRejectNoEvidence: No evidence is attached to this item — rejecting requires at least one
realRejectAttachHint: Attach your own photo below and send it.
realRejectHint: Rejection is scoped to one checklist item with evidence
realAcceptAnywayHint: A dispute is open, but you can accept the milestone at any time
realAcceptWillLocked: This can't be undone from this screen
realPayConfirmHint: Payment happens directly between the parties — the platform records the fact for the evidence base
realPayWaitingCounterparty: You confirmed the payment. Waiting for the other side to confirm.
realPaidText: Payment confirmed by both sides — the fact is recorded in the evidence base.
realPayPlatformText: The payment module isn't launched yet, so there's no pay button here. Settle directly by the agreed bank details — the parties confirm the settlement between themselves.
submitNoEvidenceWarning: No photos are attached to these checklist points. You can still submit the milestone.

actionError.notOnLeaf: This action works on a final milestone, not on a group.
actionError.invalidTransition: This action isn't available for the current milestone status.
actionError.checklistItemRequired: Pick the checklist point you're rejecting.
actionError.checklistItemWrongMilestone: This checklist point belongs to another milestone.
actionError.evidenceRequired: Attach at least one piece of evidence.
actionError.materialWrongSide: Handover is marked by the supplying side, receipt by the receiving side.
actionError.materialAlreadyReceived: The material is already marked as received.
actionError.permissionDenied: You don't have access to this action.
actionError.notFound: The data has changed — refresh the page.
actionError.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
